positions.description:
Designed and built a React app for viewing test information (status, run time, logs, etc.) for pull requests for a given repository, generated by internal continuous integration tool.

Improved administration interface by creating UI for viewing and editing flags to determine if certain modals are shown to a user.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.locationName: Tompkins County, New York, United States
positions.description:
Developed desktop software to control an HPLC column oven, consisting of a user interface (Java) and an API for sending serial commands to the column oven (C++).

Tested USB device drivers against different versions of Microsoft Windows and debugged them in order to receive Windows Hardware Quality Labs (WHQL) release signatures.

projects.title: Midd Rides App
projects.description:
Designed and built a React app for Middlebury College's evening transportation service.

Implemented authentication with Google Sign-In, role-based access control, real-time location tracking of bus, and functionality to make, edit, and cancel ride requests.
